§6Arc Welder§f

§aStick two plates together with 10,000 volts. What could go wrong?§f

The §bArc Welder§f fuses metal plates into welded components using electricity and a welding fluid. Three color-coded input slots (red, yellow, green) match the output ports. Feed it power and fluid, and it produces welded plates, steel frames, and other construction pieces.

Crafted at a §bTier 2 Anvil§f from cast steel plates, tungsten ingots, a transformer, and graphite electrodes.

Welded plates are the backbone of advanced generators, power infrastructure, and most late-game machines. You'll be coming back to this one a lot.

§ePS:§f The arc welder accepts upgrade modules (speed, power, overdrive) in the two side slots.
